design_brief: Entrance utility with a narrow footprint and recognizable front/back silhouette.
gameplay_scope: Approved passive art-library object only; no runtime/default-layout binding, coat service, reservation, action, actor pose, worker authority, persistence or gameplay transaction.

current_availability.direction_art_review: Approved as exact coat-bag-stand-v3 passive art only after native and 4x review. V3 retains v2's physical hanger, bag/shelf contact and compact shadow, then replaces its rearranged frontal views with a buttoned North front, button-free South rear yoke, and genuinely foreshortened East/West garment, bag, crossbar and shelf projections. Export 112/0, structural 412/0 and isolated actual-GameMain 183/0 checks pass; the main-agent rubric is 3/2/3/3/3/3 (2.83). The existing founder is only a route/contact/gaze/depth probe. No coat service, interaction, runtime binding or default placement is approved.

previous_catalogue_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

superseded_art_proposals.reason: Coat and bag lacked visible support: the coat began below the rack without a hanger and the bag floated above the shelf. Preserved only as rejected evidence.

V2 added a real hanger and shelf contact but rearranged substantially frontal coat/rack/shelf art across all four slots. North and South both exposed a V collar/buttons and East/West retained frontal width. Its physical-support evidence remains preserved but it is not approved directional art.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.

projection_contract.front_rear_identity: North is the buttoned V-collar garment/front-bag face; South is a button-free horizontal rear yoke and rear bag panel.
projection_contract.side_foreshortening: East/West coat width is 15px versus 27–28px front/rear; bag width 12px versus 24–25px; shelf 31px versus 52–53px; crossbar 25–26px versus 48–49px. Heights remain 69–70px for side coats and 29px for side bags, proving rotation rather than uniform miniaturization.
projection_contract.fixed_light: All four views retain screen-upper-left highlights; no finished bitmap is rotated, mirrored, flipped, scaled or sampled.

variants.redraw_requirement: Draw the actual north service front; operator approaches that side looking south. Fixed screen floor axes and upper-left light; do not rotate or mirror finished raster art. No implemented interaction is implied.
